cn_steps: 启用 `Python Foundation Packages`（Python 包内容插件，无独立运行时模块列表）。
它提供引擎插件常用的 Python 基础包，例如 NumPy 和 PyTorch。
在需要这些科学/ML 包的编辑器 Python 流程里启用本插件作为依赖。
属实验性 Python 内容；配合 Python 脚本插件使用。
en_steps: Enable `Python Foundation Packages` (Python package content plugin; no separate runtime module list).
It ships common Python packages used by engine plugins, such as NumPy and PyTorch.
Enable it as a dependency for editor Python flows that need these science/ML packages.
It is experimental Python content; used with the Python script plugin.
note_cn: 引擎插件用的常见 Python 包（NumPy、PyTorch 等）。
note_en: Common Python packages for engine plugins (NumPy, PyTorch, etc.).

cn_steps: 启用 `Python ML Package`（Python 包内容插件，无独立运行时模块列表）。
它自动安装 PyTorch 以及引擎插件使用的相关 ML 包。
在编辑器 ML/推理流程里启用，让 Python 侧能 import 这些包。
属实验性 Python 内容；常与 Foundation Packages 一起用。
en_steps: Enable `Python ML Package` (Python package content plugin; no separate runtime module list).
It auto-installs PyTorch and related ML packages used by engine plugins.
Enable it for editor ML/inference flows so Python can import those packages.
It is experimental Python content; often used with Foundation Packages.
note_cn: 自动安装 PyTorch 及相关 ML Python 包。
note_en: Auto-installs PyTorch and related ML Python packages.

cn_steps: 启用 `QUIC Messaging`（模块 `QuicMessaging`、`QuicMessagingTransport`）。
它给消息子系统加上基于 QUIC 的传输层，用于在联网计算机和设备之间收发消息。
在需要低延迟/多路复用消息通道时，把消息传输换成 QUIC。
属实验性消息传输；接口可能随版本变化。
en_steps: Enable `QUIC Messaging` (modules `QuicMessaging`, `QuicMessagingTransport`).
It adds a QUIC-based transport to the messaging subsystem for sending/receiving messages between networked computers and devices.
Switch messaging transport to QUIC when you need a low-latency, multiplexed message channel.
It is an experimental messaging transport; the contract may change across versions.
note_cn: 消息子系统的 QUIC 传输层。
note_en: QUIC transport layer for the messaging subsystem.

cn_steps: 启用 `Razer Chroma Devices`（运行时 `RazerChromaDevices`，编辑器 `RazerChromaEditor`）。
它提供在运行时设置 Razer Chroma 幻彩灯效的功能。
按游戏事件驱动键盘/鼠标灯效（击杀、血量等）。
属实验性外设灯效；需 Razer Chroma SDK/硬件。
en_steps: Enable `Razer Chroma Devices` (runtime `RazerChromaDevices`, editor `RazerChromaEditor`).
It provides functionality to set Razer Chroma lighting effects at runtime.
Drive keyboard/mouse lighting from gameplay events (kills, health, etc.).
It is experimental peripheral lighting; requires the Razer Chroma SDK/hardware.
note_cn: 运行时设置 Razer Chroma 幻彩灯效。
note_en: Set Razer Chroma lighting effects at runtime.

cn_steps: 启用 `RDG Insights`（模块 `RenderGraphInsights`）。
它允许通过 Unreal Insights 调试 Render Dependency Graph (RDG)。
开 Insights 采集渲染，查看 RDG pass/资源依赖以排查 GPU 工作。
属 Insights/Trace 可视化；开发机使用。
en_steps: Enable `RDG Insights` (module `RenderGraphInsights`).
It allows debugging the Render Dependency Graph (RDG) via Unreal Insights.
Capture rendering in Insights and inspect RDG passes/resource dependencies to triage GPU work.
It is Insights/Trace visualization; used on dev machines.
note_cn: 在 Unreal Insights 里调试 RDG。

cn_steps: 启用 `Recovery Hub`（模块 `DisasterRecoveryClient`）。
它跟踪编辑器中的更改，以便崩溃后恢复。
崩溃重启后从 Recovery Hub 还原未保存的关卡/资产编辑。
属编辑器灾难恢复客户端；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Recovery Hub` (module `DisasterRecoveryClient`).
It tracks editor changes so you can recover after a crash.
After a crash restart, restore unsaved level/asset edits from Recovery Hub.
It is an editor disaster-recovery client; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 跟踪编辑器更改，崩溃后从 Recovery Hub 恢复。
note_en: Track editor changes and recover them after a crash.

cn_steps: 启用 `Reflex`（模块 `Reflex`）。
它提供 NVIDIA Reflex 延迟跟踪和 tick rate 处理。
在支持的 NVIDIA GPU 上启用 Reflex，降低输入到显示的延迟。
属运行时延迟优化；需 NVIDIA 驱动/硬件支持。
en_steps: Enable `Reflex` (module `Reflex`).
It provides NVIDIA Reflex latency tracking and tick-rate handling.
Enable Reflex on supported NVIDIA GPUs to cut input-to-display latency.
It is a runtime latency optimization; requires NVIDIA driver/hardware support.
note_cn: NVIDIA Reflex 延迟跟踪与 tick rate 处理。
note_en: NVIDIA Reflex latency tracking and tick-rate handling.

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Control Actor Modifier Bridge`（模块 `RemoteControlActorModifierBridge`）。
它是 Remote Control、Actor Modifier 和 Property Animator 之间的接口。
远程改 Actor 修饰器/属性动画时启用本桥，让三套系统互通。
属实验性桥接；需对应的 Remote Control 与修饰器/动画器插件。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Control Actor Modifier Bridge` (module `RemoteControlActorModifierBridge`).
It is the interface between Remote Control, Actor Modifier, and Property Animator.
Enable this bridge when remotely driving actor modifiers/property animators so the three systems talk.
It is an experimental bridge; requires the matching Remote Control and modifier/animator plugins.
note_cn: Remote Control、Actor Modifier 与 Property Animator 的接口。
note_en: Interface among Remote Control, Actor Modifier, and Property Animator.

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Control API`（模块 `RemoteControl`、`RemoteControlLogic`、`WebRemoteControl`、`RemoteControlCommon`、`RemoteControlUI`、`RemoteControlProtocol`、`RemoteControlProtocolWidgets`、`RemoteControlMultiUser`）。
它是一套在编辑器或通过网络服务器在运行时控制引擎的工具，走 HTTP 或 WebSockets。
创建 Remote Control Preset，暴露属性/函数，再用第三方应用或 Web 服务远程驱动。
属虚拟制片/远程操控核心；按协议再启用 DMX/MIDI/OSC 等扩展。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Control API` (modules `RemoteControl`, `RemoteControlLogic`, `WebRemoteControl`, `RemoteControlCommon`, `RemoteControlUI`, `RemoteControlProtocol`, `RemoteControlProtocolWidgets`, `RemoteControlMultiUser`).
It is a suite of tools for controlling Unreal in editor or at runtime via a web server, over HTTP or WebSockets.
Create a Remote Control Preset, expose properties/functions, then drive them from a third-party app or web service.
It is the VP/remote-control core; enable DMX/MIDI/OSC protocol plugins as needed.
note_cn: 经 HTTP/WebSocket 远程控制引擎（编辑器或运行时）。
note_en: Control Unreal remotely over HTTP/WebSocket (editor or runtime).

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Control Components`（运行时 `RemoteControlComponents`，编辑器 `RemoteControlComponentsEditor`）。
它为 Remote Control 提供可放在 Actor 上的组件封装。
在关卡 Actor 上加 Remote Control 相关组件，把该 Actor 的属性暴露给预设。
属实验性 Remote Control 扩展；需 Remote Control API。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Control Components` (runtime `RemoteControlComponents`, editor `RemoteControlComponentsEditor`).
It provides actor-component wrappers for Remote Control.
Add Remote Control components on level actors to expose those actors' properties to presets.
It is an experimental Remote Control extension; requires Remote Control API.
note_cn: 把 Remote Control 能力封装成 Actor 组件。

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Control Interception API`（模块 `RemoteControlInterception`）。
它允许拦截 Remote Control 命令。
在命令真正生效前插入校验、重映射或日志。
属 Remote Control 扩展；需 Remote Control API。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Control Interception API` (module `RemoteControlInterception`).
It allows intercepting Remote Control commands.
Insert validation, remapping, or logging before a command takes effect.
It is a Remote Control extension; requires Remote Control API.
note_cn: 拦截 Remote Control 命令的 API。
note_en: API to intercept Remote Control commands.

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Control Protocol DMX`（运行时 `RemoteControlProtocolDMX`，编辑器 `RemoteControlProtocolDMXEditor`）。
它允许 DMX 与 Remote Control API 交互。
把灯控台 DMX 通道绑到 Remote Control Preset 属性。
需 Remote Control API 与 DMX；常用于虚拟制片现场。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Control Protocol DMX` (runtime `RemoteControlProtocolDMX`, editor `RemoteControlProtocolDMXEditor`).
It allows interactions between DMX and the Remote Control API.
Bind lighting-console DMX channels to Remote Control Preset properties.
Requires Remote Control API and DMX; common on virtual-production sets.
note_cn: DMX 与 Remote Control API 的协议桥。
note_en: Protocol bridge between DMX and Remote Control API.

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Control Protocol MIDI`（运行时 `RemoteControlProtocolMIDI`，编辑器 `RemoteControlProtocolMIDIEditor`）。
它允许 MIDI 与 Remote Control API 交互。
把 MIDI 控制器旋钮/按键绑到 Remote Control Preset 属性。
需 Remote Control API 与 MIDI 设备。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Control Protocol MIDI` (runtime `RemoteControlProtocolMIDI`, editor `RemoteControlProtocolMIDIEditor`).
It allows interactions between MIDI and the Remote Control API.
Bind MIDI controller knobs/pads to Remote Control Preset properties.
Requires Remote Control API and a MIDI device.
note_cn: MIDI 与 Remote Control API 的协议桥。
note_en: Protocol bridge between MIDI and Remote Control API.

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Control Protocol OSC`（模块 `RemoteControlProtocolOSC`）。
它允许 OSC 与 Remote Control API 交互。
把 OSC 地址绑到 Remote Control Preset，接收外部控制台/软件的消息。
需 Remote Control API 与 OSC 插件。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Control Protocol OSC` (module `RemoteControlProtocolOSC`).
It allows interactions between OSC and the Remote Control API.
Bind OSC addresses to a Remote Control Preset to receive messages from external consoles/apps.
Requires Remote Control API and the OSC plugin.
note_cn: OSC 与 Remote Control API 的协议桥。
note_en: Protocol bridge between OSC and Remote Control API.

cn_steps: 启用 `Remote Control Web Interface`（模块 `RemoteControlWebInterface`）。
它提供通过预设控制引擎的 Web 界面，需要安装 Node.js。
启动 Web 界面后，用浏览器打开预设面板远程调参。
属 Remote Control 前端；需 Remote Control API 与本机 Node.js。
en_steps: Enable `Remote Control Web Interface` (module `RemoteControlWebInterface`).
It provides a web interface to control Unreal via presets; requires Node.js installed.
Start the web UI, then open the preset panel in a browser to tweak remotely.
It is a Remote Control frontend; requires Remote Control API and local Node.js.
note_cn: 用浏览器经预设控制引擎的 Web 界面（需 Node.js）。
note_en: Web UI to control Unreal via presets (requires Node.js).
